strongest_angle: Researchers at Freie Universität Berlin published a new theoretical framework on November 5, 2026, investigating whether high-precision measurements of lunar tides in the Earth-Moon system contain relativistic traces from Einstein's general relativity alongside Newton's classical gravity.

key_facts.fact: Freie Universität Berlin published information on November 5, 2026, regarding a new theoretical framework developed to search lunar tides for relativistic traces.
Phys.org published an article on November 5, 2026, by Christine Xuan Müller regarding the intersection of Einstein's gravitational waves and Newton's tides at Free University of Berlin.
The Earth-Moon system is used by researchers at Freie Universität Berlin because tidal effects can already be described and measured very precisely.
